# design-os-svg-animation

> Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps motion video pipeline for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity). Motion IR compiler, virtual clock quantizing, proactive pre-flight guard, and 6 anti-flop verification gates.

A motion engineering pipeline that compiles Motion IR storyboards to CSS and GSAP, renders broadcast MP4s with headless Chromium virtual clocks, and audits output against proactive pre-flight quality guards and 6 anti-flop gates.

## Core Features & Workflow

- **Motion IR**: JSON intermediate representation capturing keyframes, easings, spatial trajectories, and timeline markers.
- **Virtual Clock Engine**: Drives headless Chromium via explicit timestamp increments (1/60s), eliminating dropped frames.
- **Hairline Engine**: Interactive 2:1 axonometric vector instruments with spring-driven kinematics, dynamic SVG depth sorting, and meaningful physical interaction.
- **Pre-Flight Guard & 6 Anti-Flop Gates**: Boundary clipping prevention, SVG glyph fill audits, camera decoupling, frame drift, color gamut, font loading, and timeline integrity audits.
